create.name: Kandō Bion Boncutiu
create.bio:
Kandō Bion Boncutiu, known to most of his students simply as Bion, is an ordained monk and Dharma teacher in the Soto Zen tradition who lives near Madrid. He trained in the line that runs from Dōgen through Gudō Wafu Nishijima to Jundo Cohen Roshi, from whom his Insight Timer profile says he received Dharma transmission in May 2026, and he is a teacher with Treeleaf Zendo, an international Zen community that meets largely online. He teaches in English, Spanish and Romanian.

His teaching rests on shikantaza, or just sitting, read alongside the early Buddhist discourses and Dōgen's writings, and it keeps coming back to one question: how to meet ordinary life with less grasping and more ease. He holds zazen online on several evenings a week, including Dharma Tuesdays, which pairs a sitting period with study, and twice a month he leads open practice at the Unsui Zen space in Madrid, mostly in Spanish. In keeping with monastic custom his teaching is given freely and supported by donations. He writes essays on practice on his Bodhipatha Substack and posts Dharma talks in English and Spanish on YouTube.

courses.title: Becoming Intimate With The Person You Call Me
courses.description: Bion's Insight Timer course, which uses Zen practice to look closely at the self we usually take for granted. Taken in short daily sessions inside the app.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Kandō Bion Boncutiu on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided zazen sittings and short Dharma talks from Bion, free to listen to on Insight Timer. A good way to sit with him between live sessions.

free_resources.title: Dharma Tuesdays: Online Zazen and Study
free_resources.description: A free weekly online meeting in English at 8 pm Madrid time: one period of zazen, then study of the Buddha's teachings, closing with a chanted dedication. Joined through a browser on kMeet after signing up.

free_resources.title: Online Zazen with Bion
free_resources.description: Regular evening sittings online during the week in English and Spanish, open to anyone, with a short recitation at the end. Free, with donations welcome.

free_resources.title: Zazen at Unsui Zen, Madrid
free_resources.description: In-person Soto Zen practice on the second and fourth Sunday of each month in Madrid, with sitting, walking meditation, a short ceremony and a talk with questions. Mostly in Spanish, free of charge, and also open online.
